name: rookiegamers
description: Build web games on the RookieGamers SDK and publish them to rookiegamers.com, where every game shares one player account, leaderboards, a Hall of Fame and cross-promotion.

interface.longDescription: RookieGamers is a web game portal for indie developers, and AI-built games are welcome. Connect your RookieGamers developer account and ChatGPT can read the SDK docs, start from a working starter game, upload your build, run the publishing checks and put the game live at rookiegamers.com/play/<your-game>. It can also show your plays, leaderboards, store products and earnings, and set up store items and ads when you ask.
defaultPrompt: Make a one-button rhythm game on the RookieGamers SDK and publish it.
How are my RookieGamers games doing this month?

positive.prompt: How do I submit a score to a RookieGamers leaderboard?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the docs and explains rg.scores.submit with a short code example.

positive.prompt: Give me a RookieGamers starter game called sky-hop.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the starter files (index.html with the SDK script tag) and the next steps to publish.

positive.prompt: What games are live on RookieGamers right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the live games with titles and play links.

positive.prompt: Which of my RookieGamers games are published?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's games with live status and version.

positive.prompt: Show the all-time leaderboard for unsays.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the top scores for the unsays all-time board.

negative.description: Must not publish or unpublish without being asked
negative.prompt: Tell me what publishing a game on RookieGamers involves.

negative.description: Must not accept ad terms for the developer
negative.prompt: Explain how RookieGamers ads pay developers.

review.commerce_description: No purchases happen in ChatGPT. Developers can define store products for their own games; players buy them later on rookiegamers.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: SDK docs, starter game, publishing, stats, leaderboards and store setup.
